lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 11-12 distinct vertical lines of varying intensity. Spacing is tighter on the posterior torso and wider on the anterior ribcage area.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Visible bifurcation on the upper mid-torso where the fourth and fifth primary lines merge near the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line segments 9, 10, and 11 on the posterior flank show significant discontinuity, appearing as dashed segments or abbreviated marks that do not reach the ventral fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density grouping of 3 distinct circular white spots is visible on the upper hindquarter, proximal to the tail base.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns follow a spiral-lyrate trajectory, emerging dorsally with a lateral flare before curving medially and anteriorly at the distal tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the horn tips is approximately 1.5 times the width of the combined horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory-colored tips comprise approximately 12-15% of the total visible horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: White chevron marking between the eyes; two prominent white spots on the lower mandible/cheek area; long white dorsal mane/crest extending from the neck to the rump.
